origin.description: Replaces missing numbers with the column median.
origin.details: The median is the same one R uses by default.
origin.value: The filled matrix, column by column.

translation.description: Replaces missing numbers with the column median.
translation.details: The median is the same one R uses by default.
translation.value: The filled matrix, column by column.
translation.example: print(" ".join(str(v) for column in zip(*na_roughfix([[1, 10], [float("nan"), 2], [3, 6], [8, float("nan")]])) for v in column))
